name: School ERP API
description:
Complete REST API for School ERP SaaS platform covering all 200+ modules and 250+ routes.

## Features
- Multi-tenant architecture
- JWT authentication
- Role-based access control
- Comprehensive CRUD operations
- Advanced filtering and search
- Bulk operations
- File uploads
- Real-time notifications

## Authentication
All endpoints require JWT Bearer token authentication. Include the token in the Authorization header:
```
Authorization: Bearer <your_jwt_token>
```

## Multi-Tenancy
All endpoints are tenant-scoped. Include the school ID in the X-School-ID header:
```
X-School-ID: <school_id>
```
